Co-op · Original monsters · Normal · Up to 8 players

Start a game with Esc → Single Player → New Game. Use the in-game menus to change controls, difficulty, video, sound, and saves. Mouse capture and audio require a click.

The installed data contains the first episode. Select pak0.pak and pak1.pak from your purchased copy before launching to play the full campaign. Files you select stay on your computer.

The original shareware is available as a complete, unchanged archive. Its original license accompanies the game data.

Click Join co-op to fight Quake's original monsters together on the shared server. Up to eight players share the campaign, enemies, and level progress. Other players can open this page and join the same game. Use Quake's console to chat with say hello. Single-player saves remain available after leaving multiplayer.

Multiplayer uses WebTransport.

This build runs QuakeSpasm through WebAssembly and GL4ES. The installed shareware data has no CD soundtrack.
